data.comment:
Producer decision (this session): Option 1 for F2 — the core repo must contain NO game code. All game-coupled core files move to their owning game repos; Gym's card-index demo is genericised to core-only types.

Per-file dispositions decided:
- (A) src/ui/debug/{MarketCardCheatOverlay,StaffApplicantCheatOverlay}.ts -> tce-main-street (they are Main Street cheat tools, consumed only by MainStreetScene).
- (B) scripts/balance/** and src/balance-cards/** Main-Street-coupled parts -> tce-main-street (balance tooling is materially Main-Street-specific).
- (C) game-specific scripts/ generators + adapters -> their owning game repos.
- (D) example-games/gym/GymCardIndex.ts -> genericise to core card types (Gym stays the core feature demonstrator, using only core-owned APIs).
- (E) core tests that reference games -> move to the owning game repo, or rewrite against core fixtures.

GitHub repo creation is NOT authorised yet. The producer requires the intended repo list for review before any repo is created. F4 will halt at that gate.
